Priya: can you share the baseline vs ab aggregates?
Diego: baseline (v3.9) -> recall@50 0.82, longdoc_recall@50 0.74, avg_latency 180ms
Diego: candidate (v4.0-int6) -> recall@50 0.81, longdoc_recall@50 0.66, avg_latency 140ms

Kai: int6 encoding might degrade long-context locality. did we run KV-warmup for long docs?

Nora: proposal: hold promotion. add canary gating rule: block promotion if longdoc_recall delta <= -3.0pp OR any client_slice recall drop >5pp. auto-fallback window = 10k requests or 12h, whichever first.
Priya: +1. also add an immediate alert on the canary dashboard when longdoc_recall slope < -0.5pp/hr.
Kai: add a temporary mitigation: enable chunk_overlap=0.3 and rerun replay; if recall recovers >-1.0pp we can re-evaluate for phased promote.
Diego: starting replay + overlap test now. tagging @Nora for eval handoff. will post results in ~90m.
Nora: thanks. if replay still bad, plan is to rollback and open IR-4342 for quant-longdoc investigation.
